dropped.finding: The pre-existing public library function `rebar.attach_commits` now narrows its accepted input: it rejects any SHA that does not resolve to a commit in the local repo (raising RebarError), whereas it previously accepted any non-empty SHA string. This is an unversioned narrowing of a public surface — an external embedder that attached a not-yet-fetched or foreign-clone SHA now gets a hard error with no migration path.
scenarios: An external library user calls rebar.attach_commits(tid, [sha]) with a SHA that is valid but not yet fetched into the local clone — previously recorded, now raises RebarError.
A caller pre-linking a commit by its known SHA before the object exists locally.

dropped.finding: The descendant-scope symmetry that is the stated reason for _union_file_impact (unioning impact across the ticket's transitive descendants so a parent is not false-blocked by child-owned paths) is never verified: every DET test monkeypatches _union_file_impact and _attached_commit_shas to return injected lists, so their real reduce/descendant traversal is untested.
scenarios: A regression that read only the target ticket's file_impact (dropping the descendant union) would false-block a parent, but no test would fail because the union helper is always stubbed
